calendarFaqs.q: When did Bellevue School District start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Students in grades 1–12 started Tuesday, September 2, 2025. Kindergarten WA Kids ran September 2–4, and kindergarten students started Friday, September 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Bellevue School District Winter Break in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break ran December 22, 2025, through January 2, 2026. Students returned Monday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: Were the November BSD conference dates full no-school days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. November 3, 4, 6, and 7 were elementary conference early-release days. The PDF does not list November 5 as one of those early-release conference dates.

calendarFaqs.q: Why did Bellevue's 2025–26 last day change?
calendarFaqs.a: The revised PDF moved the last day from June 18 to June 23, 2026, and moved the two end-of-year emergency make-up dates from June 22–23 to June 24–25.

calendarFaqs.q: Were Bellevue emergency make-up dates automatic school days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. October 10, March 27, and May 26 were published as non-school dates with conditional emergency use. June 24–25 were reserved after the scheduled last day. Families needed a BSD announcement to know whether a date was activated.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the Bellevue calendar PDF update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. BSD says printable calendars are static copies and will not reflect future changes. The official calendar page offers website calendar subscriptions for update notifications.
